title: Enterprise Media, OTT Streaming & Global Gaming LiveOps Localization, Lip-Sync Dubbing, Cultural/Age-Rating Compliance & Churn-Prevention Agent

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Manual Localization Studios + Rule-Based LiveOps Promos
tiers.architecture: External human translation/dubbing vendors across 18 languages (6-week patch lag) + blanket 20% discount coupons sent to all inactive players

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Raw Machine Translation + Unconstrained Zero-Shot TTS
tiers.architecture: Line-by-line LLM/MT translation without character register or UI box constraints + unconstrained TTS that overflows lip-sync windows by +35%

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Glossary RAG Translation + Propensity Churn Scoring
tiers.architecture: Vector RAG over lore glossaries (no syllable-duration constraint or UI pixel width renderer) + churn propensity model that wastes promos on 'Sure Things'

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Glossary-Locked Isochronous Dubbing + Regional Rating VLM/AST Gate + Causal Uplift LiveOps Agent
tiers.architecture: Finite-State Lore Glossary + Syllable/Pixel-Bounded Translation + Prosody-Aligned MuseTalk/Wav2Lip Dubbing + ESRB/PEGI/GAPP Visual/Text AST Gate + T-Learner Causal Uplift

scenarios.scenario: Isochronous Lip-Sync & UI Text-Box Overflow Gate (EN -> DE/JA/ES Cutscene & HUD)
scenarios.question: Localize a 2.8-second English cutscene line ('Strike the Aegis Core now!') and a 140px HUD button into German and Japanese without overflowing audio duration or UI width
scenarios.model_answer: Enforce FST glossary ('Aegis Core' -> locked term), constrain phoneme duration within +/-5% of 2.80s source viseme track, and verify rendered font glyph width <= 140px
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 German translation expands character length by +42% (truncating HUD button text) and runs 3.85s long (+1.05s audio desync after lips close).

scenarios.scenario: Japanese/Korean Honorific Register & Speaker-Addressee Graph Enforcement
scenarios.question: Translate dialogue where a loyal knight addresses the Empress in Scene 4 and a street rogue in Scene 5 (source English uses generic 'you' in both)
scenarios.model_answer: Inject directed Speaker->Addressee social-hierarchy graph edge into prompt AST; enforce Keigo (Sonkeigo/Kenjougo) for Empress and rough casual register for rogue
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 line-by-line MT translates both with polite 'Anata/Desu-Masu', destroying character immersion and triggering community review backlash.

scenarios.scenario: Multi-Region Age-Rating & Cultural Compliance Gate (ESRB Teen / PEGI 12 / GAPP / MENA)
scenarios.question: Audit a seasonal LiveOps skin bundle + quest dialogue containing skeletal motifs, simulated loot-box odds, and alcohol references across 18 regional storefronts
scenarios.model_answer: Run VLM asset scanner + statutory rule AST (GAPP skeleton/blood ban, PEGI/Belgian paid-loot-box probability disclosure, ESRB Teen alcohol bounds); auto-route regional variant assets
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1/2 ships unflagged skeletal texture and missing gacha probability table, causing app-store takedown and 3-week seasonal launch freeze.

scenarios.scenario: Causal Uplift LiveOps Retention vs. Naive Churn Propensity Cannibalization
scenarios.question: Allocate $5 reward packs across 5M DAU to maximize incremental 30-day retention without subsidizing 'Sure Things' or triggering 'Sleeping Dogs'
scenarios.model_answer: Score CATE = E[Y|T=1,X] - E[Y|T=0,X] via Causal Forest / T-Learner; target only 'Persuadables' (CATE > +8% retention lift) and suppress 'Sure Things' & 'Lost Causes'
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 churn propensity model sends 68% of coupons to 'Lost Causes' (who churn anyway) and high-spend 'Sure Things' (cannibalizing $180K/mo organic IAP).

perturbation_checks.check: Hotfix Emergency Narrative Patch (4,500 Lines + 60 Min Audio Across 18 Languages Before Simultaneous Global Sim-Ship)
Adversarial Slang & Homophone Injection in User-Generated / LiveOps Event Text

key_findings: Tier 4 (Glossary-Locked FST + Phoneme-Isochronous Dubbing + Regional Age-Rating AST + Causal Uplift LiveOps) compresses global 18-language simultaneous shipping ('Sim-Ship') from 1,008 hours (6 weeks) to 2.5 hours.
Combining FreeType glyph-pixel width verification with prosody-aligned viseme duration control cuts UI text truncation and lip-sync desync from 42.0% down to 0.4%.

Replacing naive churn propensity scoring with Causal Uplift (CATE) targeting eliminates promo cannibalization on 'Sure Things', reducing monthly localization and LiveOps promo waste from $460K to $52K (-88.7%).
